proposals.rationale: The public door cannot open without a pre-turn hook, and policy.hooks must name a verb already in the catalog. This verb is that hook: it asserts the "ssh" identity namespace by verifying an ssh-ed25519 signature over the message (signing namespace "mshkn") against mike's public key, and prints "mike" on success, making the public principal "ssh:mike". Verified with try: it builds; a bad signature yields no stdout; a valid signature yields exactly "mike".
proposals.title: Add ssh_assert pre-turn identity hook

verb.description: Pre-turn identity hook for the ssh namespace: receives the decoded public payload, verifies an ssh-ed25519 signature over msg (signing namespace mshkn) against mike's public key, and prints the asserted principal name (mike).
verb.dockerfile:
FROM mshkn-base
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssh-client jq && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN mkdir -p /verb
RUN printf '%s\n' 'mike namespaces="mshkn" ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIG154gX7jH0Cp32UFCVOebkQwhBFFD39nABbYF1cZzHj mike' > /verb/allowed_signers
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'payload="$1"' 'msg=$(printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -r .msg)' 'sig=$(printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -r .signature)' 'printf "%s" "$msg" > /tmp/msg' 'printf "%s" "$sig" > /tmp/sig' 'ssh-keygen -Y verify -f /verb/allowed_signers -I mike -n mshkn -s /tmp/sig < /tmp/msg >/dev/null 2>&1' 'printf "%s" "mike"' > /verb/run.sh
RUN chmod +x /verb/run.sh
verb.name: ssh_assert

proposals.rationale: Open the public door so root (signing as mike) can reach the embryo from outside the authenticated door. The ssh_assert pre-turn hook (p-1, approved) verifies ssh-ed25519 signatures in namespace mshkn against mike's public key and asserts principal ssh:mike on success. This policy registers that hook, opens the door, keeps anonymous callers powerless (invoke=[], propose=false), and grants ssh:mike full invocation and proposal rights. Root remains all-powerful regardless of what the policy omits.
